macros.name: actionsocg
macros.doc: The \actionsocg macro transforms its fourth argument into a clickable link.

macros.name: hideocg
macros.doc: The \hideocg macro turns its second argument into a clickable link that make invisible all OCGs whose references are listed in its first argument: a visible OCG becomes invisible and an OCG already invisible remains invisible.

macros.name: showocg
macros.doc: The \showocg macro turns its second argument into a clickable link that make visible all OCGs whose references are listed in its first argument: an invisible OCG becomes visible and an OCG already visible remains visible.

macros.name: switchocg
macros.doc: The \switchocg macro turns its second argument into a clickable link that toggles the visibility status of all listed OCGs (by their reference) in its first argument: if an OCG was visible, it becomes invisible, and conversely, if an OCG was invisible, it becomes visible.
